name: library-reservations-explainer
description: Source for the staff explainer video. Films the real app against local Firebase emulators, then composites and scores it. See README.md.

scripts.film: mkdir -p .cache && cp ../firestore.rules .cache/ && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-library-reservations "node film/film.js"
scripts.emulators: mkdir -p .cache && cp ../firestore.rules .cache/ && firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project demo-library-reservations
